question.name: CSEC Phy May 2022 Q2c(i) — Weight of a Basketball
question.text:
A basketball has a mass of 500 g.

Calculate its weight in newtons. [Acceleration due to gravity, g = 10 m s⁻²] (3 marks)
question.general_feedback:
Model solution:
Convert: m = 500 g = 0.5 kg
W = mg = 0.5 × 10 = 5 N

steps.label:
Given: mass = 500 g  |  g = 10 m s⁻²
Formula: W = mg  |  Unit conversion: 1 kg = 1000 g
Convert mass to kg, then calculate the weight W. (3 marks)

error_codes.SC_CALCULATION_ERROR: Convert grams to kilograms: m = 500 ÷ 1000 = 0.5 kg.

error_codes.SC_FORMULA_SELECTION_ERROR: Weight W = mg. Multiply mass (in kg) by g = 10 m/s².
